```bash
     https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/trello.com/url_list \

```


* You handle rate‑limiting responses appropriately (e.g., back off when you receive HTTP 429).
* If you run into permission issues, double-check that the key belongs to a plan that includes domain‑URL enumeration.

Let me know if you'd prefer step‑by‑step guidance on setting up the curl command locally, handling JSON output, or parsing the response programmatically!
